package streamdeadline

import (
    "errors"
    "math"
    "os"
    "testing"
    time "example.invalid/streamdeadline/faketime"
)

// The exact production function uses an explicit clock and WIT-option double.
// Provider behavior below is modeled; this does not execute a component.
func future(n int64) time.Time { return time.Time{Remaining: n} }

func TestLongDeadlineEntersProviderWithAcceptedArgument(t *testing.T) {
    option, err := lsfStreamTimeout(future(11000000000))
    if err != nil || !option.Present || option.Value == 0 || option.Value > 10000 {
        t.Fatalf("provider-timeout-argument-rejected: value=%d present=%v error=%v", option.Value, option.Present, err)
    }
}

func TestNoDeadlineAndExpiredDeadline(t *testing.T) {
    option, err := lsfStreamTimeout(time.Time{Empty: true})
    if err != nil || option.Present { t.Fatal("zero deadline did not remain absent") }
    for _, remaining := range []int64{-1, 0} {
        option, err := lsfStreamTimeout(future(remaining))
        if option.Present || !errors.Is(err, os.ErrDeadlineExceeded) { t.Fatalf("expired: %d", remaining) }
    }
}

func TestCeilingAndProviderMaximum(t *testing.T) {
    cases := []struct{ remaining int64; want uint32 }{
        {1, 1}, {999999, 1}, {1000000, 1}, {1000001, 2},
        {9999999999, 10000}, {10000000000, 10000}, {10000000001, 10000}, {math.MaxInt64, 10000},
    }
    for _, item := range cases {
        option, err := lsfStreamTimeout(future(item.remaining))
        if err != nil || !option.Present || option.Value != item.want {
            t.Fatalf("rounding-cap remaining=%d got=%v err=%v want=%d", item.remaining, option, err, item.want)
        }
    }
}

func TestProviderModelRetainsNarrowerOriginalDeadline(t *testing.T) {
    option, err := lsfStreamTimeout(future(20000000000))
    if err != nil || !option.Present { t.Fatal("long deadline") }
    // This models the provider minimum; the separate source checks and signed
    // owners authenticate the real provider/root path independently.
    rootMillis, providerMillis := uint32(900), uint32(10000)
    effective := option.Value
    if rootMillis < effective { effective = rootMillis }
    if providerMillis < effective { effective = providerMillis }
    if effective != rootMillis { t.Fatal("root deadline was extended") }
}
